name: Cart over budget (product defect)
description: The cart subtotal is higher than budget_per_item x items. This is the business rule under test.

name: Element not found (page layout changed)
description: None of the candidate selectors matched. Update the locator in the page object.

name: Blocked by bot protection
description: eBay rejected the request (HTTP 403/429) or served a CAPTCHA. Environmental, not a test defect - slow down (slow_mo_ms) or retry later.

name: eBay error page
description: eBay kept showing an error page (5xx, 'Something went wrong') even after refreshing. Site-side issue - re-run later.

name: Login failed
description: Credentials were configured but sign-in did not succeed (wrong password, changed sign-in page).

name: Add to cart not confirmed
description: The item page did not confirm the item was added (out of stock, variant not selectable, etc.).

name: Price could not be parsed
description: A price string had an unexpected format.

name: No items in price range
description: Search returned nothing under max_price, so the scenario was skipped.

name: Timeouts
description: Page or element did not respond in time (slow network, heavy page).

name: Other assertion failures
description: A failed assertion that is not one of the known causes above.

name: Unexpected errors
description: An exception that is not one of the known causes above - investigate the stack trace.
